pass_a_gloss: The soul of-me he-turned-back, he-guided me upon paths of-righteousness, for-the-sake of-the name of-him. He-mounted for just-as the shepherd, and wore-beforehand paths, as of-own of-him sheep to-the tracks to-follow. Righteousness indeed then the practical of-the just habit, of-which the according-to the activity paths. If and righteousness should-say someone the generic virtue, paths he-will-say of-this the according-to species virtues, upon which he-guides the the of-him appellation inscribing. The soul of-me, he-says, he-turned-back, having-wandered out-of the own or having-fallen-down; or having-fallen-out the soul turns-back the Lord, and restores after the to-shepherd, and into place of-green-grass is-encamped; then having-turned-back he-guides upon paths of-righteousness and of-virtue.
pass_b_english: “He turned back my soul; he guided me upon paths of righteousness, for the sake of his name” (Psalm 22:3).

For he mounted as the shepherd, and wore paths beforehand, so that his own sheep might follow in the tracks. Righteousness then is the practical habit of the just, whose paths are according to the activity. And if someone should call righteousness the generic virtue, he will say that its paths are the virtues according to species, upon which he guides the one who inscribes his appellation.

“He turned back my soul,” he says, that had wandered from its own or had fallen down; or the Lord turns back the soul that has fallen out, and restores it after the shepherding, and it is encamped into a place of green grass; then having turned it back he guides upon paths of righteousness and virtue.

choices.term: Δικαιοσύνη μὲν οὖν ἡ πρακτικὴ τῶν δικαίων ἕξις
choices.english: righteousness then is the practical habit of the just
choices.why: ἕξις is habit, not a sudden act. OCR ε ξις.
rejected: righteousness is only a sudden act
righteousness is generic virtue only, with no practical habit

choices.term: τρίβους ἐρεῖ ταύτης τὰς κατ' εἶδος ἀρετάς
choices.english: he will say that its paths are the virtues according to species
choices.why: If righteousness is generic virtue, the paths are the species-virtues. OCR κατ' ει δος.
rejected: the paths are the generic virtue itself
